Koochiching County District Court

Address: 715 4th St, International Falls, MN 56649, United States

Phone: Phone: 218-283-1160Fax: 218-283-1162

Koochiching County District Court plays a vital role in the judicial system of Koochiching County, Minnesota. As a fundamental part of the state's court system, the district court ensures the administration of justice, resolving legal disputes, and upholding the rule of law within its jurisdiction. This article delves into the history, jurisdiction, procedures, and significance of the Koochiching County District Court.

History of Koochiching County District Court

The establishment of the Koochiching County District Court dates back to its early years of statehood. Founded in 1910. it has served as a cornerstone of the local legal system ever since. Over the years, the court has witnessed numerous milestones, which have contributed to its growth and development.
